title: Research deep enough to bet on
description: Deep research with a source for every claim, market maps, websites turned into spreadsheets, and Routines that tell you when something changes.
introduction: A search engine gives you ten links. Strawberry opens them, follows the ones behind them, reads the pages that need a login, and keeps a link to every source it used.
That's the difference between a summary you'd forward and research you'd make a decision on.

blocks.text: Not sure where to start? Your companion can look at the work you have open and suggest the first thing worth handing over.

skill.context: Ask your companion to look at your work and suggest the first thing to hand over.

blocks.text: A company, a market, a technology, a person. Tell Strawberry what decision the research is for, and it works out how deep to go and brings back an answer with the sources beside every claim.

sections.title: Map every player in a market

blocks.text: Strawberry finds the companies in a niche, groups them, and compares them, including the small ones search engines barely index.
Directories, listings, catalogs, and public records become clean rows and columns, with a link to the source on every row.

items.context: Get a checked sample of rows before the full extraction.

blocks.text: Competitors, prices, regulations, job posts. A Routine checks on a schedule and only tells you when something actually changed.
Strawberry turns findings into a deck that leads with the answer, in your brand, with real screenshots and charts.

items.context: Agree the story first, then get a finished deck.

items: Compare vendors or tools side by side with current pricing.
Research a person or company before a meeting.
Build a list of companies that match specific criteria.

blocks.text: Keep research in the team workspace and nobody starts from zero. The next person picks up where the last one stopped, sources and all.
Save how your team researches as a team skill, and every companion checks the same sources to the same standard.
